PC: Highlight warning signs and problems (hypoglycemia or hyperglycemia symptoms)
Monitors the status of the patient
SBP: Uses resources efficiently to maximize team performance
Delegates tasks or assignments, as appropriate
Monitors fellow team members to ensure safety and prevent errors
Monitors the environment for safety and availability of resources (e.g. equipment)
Monitors profess toward the goad and identifies changes that could alter the plan of care
ICS: Include patient as a full partner in the discharge process
Educate the patient in plain language about condition (no medical jargon used)
Assess patient understanding/patient teach back (asked patient to repeat back)
Provide information in small chunks and repeat key pieces of information
Includes patients and families as part of the team
Provides brief, clear, specific, and timely information to team members
Seeks information from all available sources
Uses check back to verify information that is communicated
Uses SBAR, call-outs, and handoff techniques to communicate effectively with team members
Fosters communication to ensure that team members have a shared mental model
